verses.2: Do not fail to be hospitable, for through this act of hospitality, some guests were able to receive messages from angels.
verses.3: Remember that the bonds are connected to each other; those who are bound together are also part of the same body.
verses.4: A marriage is truly a noble thing, and it’s also a good thing for all people. For God judges those who are prostitutes and adulterers.
verses.5: It’s a dishonest way of doing things. It’s unacceptable for those who are supposed to be responsible for it. He himself said that: “I won’t abandon you, nor will I let you go.”
verses.6: So, in order to be happy, let us say this: “Lord is my helper; I will not fear. What can a man do to me?”
verses.7: Remember the leaders of your people, who spoke to you about the word of God. By following their teachings, you can imitate their faith and thereby determine the direction of your life.
verses.8: Jesus Christ, both in the past and today, and forevermore.
verses.9: You must teach the various and strange things carefully; for it is good to be sure of one’s heart, not by means of spices, since those were not useful to those who traveled.
verses.10: We have a sanctuary from which those who worship in it do not have the right to eat.
verses.11: For in doing this, the blood of animals is used for the sake of sin, to be poured into the sacred vessels by the high priest. The bodies of these animals are then thrown outside the sanctuary.
verses.12: Therefore, Jesus also went out beyond the gates, in order to sanctify the people through His own blood.
verses.13: Therefore, let us go out to him outside the encirclement, carrying his glory with us.
verses.14: For we do not possess the city that has already been established, but rather, we strive for the city that will be established in the future.
verses.15: Therefore, we offer this sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord, for all things. This is the fruit of those who confess His name.
verses.16: Do not fail to be kind and friendly towards others. For with such sacrifices, the God will bless you.
verses.17: Believe those who are in positions of authority among you, and obey them. For they will act as intermediaries between your souls and their words. In this way, they can carry out this task with joy, without any hesitation. After all, they are meant to help you fully.
verses.18: Pray for us, so that we may have a good sense of rightness. We truly desire to turn around and act in the right way.
verses.19: I truly hope that you will do this, so that I can restore order to your situation as soon as possible.
verses.20: But the God of peace, who brought back from the dead the leader of the sheep, the great man who was buried in the mud of time. Our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.21: We desire to be good in everything that we do, so as to fulfill His will. May we do what is pleasing to Him through Jesus Christ, whose glory will last forever. Amen.
verses.22: I ask you, brothers, to refrain from interrupting my speech. After all, I have sent you here for a brief time.
verses.23: Please pay attention to our brother Timotheus, who has been sent away. I hope that I will see you soon.
verses.24: You have all taken the leaders of your people, and also all the holy ones. Those from Italy are also taking over from you.
verses.25: The grace is with you after all.
